title: Customer accounts
subtitle: Record credit sales on a customer's account from the POS, track what they owe here and log repayments — the balance is computed automatically from invoices, returns and payments.
searchHint: Search by name or phone number
emptyList: No customers yet — add one or record a credit sale from the POS.
pickHint: Pick a customer from the list to view their statement and record repayments.
emptyStatement: No transactions yet — the first credit sale for this customer will appear here.
amountInvalid: Enter the payment amount in EGP, e.g. 50.00
paymentsHint: The amount is in EGP and is converted to piastres internally — it appears in the statement immediately and reduces the customer's balance.
